items.title: $TLT, the 20-year U.S. Treasury ETF, is trading now below $82 for the first time since 2004. YTD, it’s down almost 7%, and it’s down over 52% from its 2020 all-time high. So much for U.S. Treasury bonds being risk-free. The losses are much greater when adjusted for inflation.
